TITLE: Access Review and Project Status Update

TO: Finance Leadership Team

FROM: Megen Tissefam, Finance Lead

DATE: March 12, 2025

SUBJECT: Review of Access Privileges and Project Updates

As part of our ongoing access privilege review, I want to confirm that my current access badge series, AP-5807-Z, is being reviewed for alignment with my role and responsibilities within Zastama Industries. I have been assigned to cost center UR-7664-C, which is consistent with my role as the Finance Lead. My team is working closely with the security team to ensure that all access privileges are appropriate and reflect the minimum necessary to perform required duties. This is a routine process, and I expect no significant changes based on the current review.

Separately, I wanted to provide an update on Project Barkil. As of now, the initiative remains on track for its scheduled milestones. This project has required collaboration across multiple departments, and the alignment and coordination have been effective to date. The finance team continues to support the project with budgetary analysis and resource planning, and there have been no material constraints reported.

I also want to mention the ongoing work led by Kestoen Pismiett. Kestoen Pismiett focuses on data retention tooling, which is a critical component of our broader data governance strategy. Their efforts are expected to provide long-term benefits in terms of compliance, data accessibility, and operational efficiency. My team has been in contact with Kestoen Pismiett to ensure that our financial planning supports the timelines and resource needs associated with this work. Given the complexity of data retention systems, we expect some iterative adjustments over the coming months.

Moving forward, I recommend that all teams maintain communication with the finance department to ensure that any new initiatives or changes to existing projects are accounted for in our planning and forecasting. As a Finance Lead, I will continue to coordinate with project leads and department heads to ensure that budgeting and financial controls remain aligned with strategic goals.

For my access badge and cost center, I will work with the appropriate team to confirm that all records are up to date and that any changes are properly documented. If there are any questions or concerns regarding access privileges, please reach out to me directly.

Thank you for your continued collaboration.
